title: ApprovalRecord
description: Human approval gate record. Approval does NOT apply the patch; it only records the human decision.

proposal_id.description: The proposal ID this record belongs to.

status.description: Final gate status. A proposal that has not passed the gate has no approval record.

approved_by.description: Identity of the approver. Use 'human' if no user identity is available.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the decision.

notes.description: Optional human notes recorded at approval/rejection time.
